SELECT MAX(book_id) FROM Book
INSERT INTO Book (title, price, publish_date, isbn, publisher_id, category_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{price}, #{publish_date, jdbcType=DATE}, #{isbn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{publisher_id}, #{category_id})
mapper.update: UPDATE Book SET title = #{title}, price = #{price}, publish_date = #{publish_date, jdbcType=DATE}, isbn = #{isbn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, publisher_id = #{publisher_id}, category_id = #{category_id} WHERE book_id = #{book_id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.book_id, b.title, b.price, b.cover_image, NVL(AVG(r.rating), 0) AS average_rating FROM Book b LEFT JOIN Book_Review r ON b.book_id = r.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title, b.price, b.cover_image ORDER BY average_rating DESC, b.book_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 4

SELECT b.book_id, b.title, b.price, b.publish_date, b.isbn, b.cover_image, p.name AS publisher_name, c.name AS category_name, i.current_stock FROM Book b LEFT JOIN Publisher p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id LEFT JOIN Category c ON b.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN Inventory i ON b.book_id = i.book_id WHERE b.book_id = #{book_id}

SELECT DISTINCT b.book_id, b.title, b.price, b.cover_image, p.name AS publisher_name FROM Book b LEFT JOIN Publisher p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id LEFT JOIN Book_Author_Map bam ON b.book_id = bam.book_id LEFT JOIN Author a ON bam.author_id = a.author_id
